title: Pilots seeing UAP at Lemoore, Fallon and Pax River
place_text: Norfolk/Virginia Beach, the California coast, Lemoore, Fallon, Pax River

tellings.quote: Um, further inland, Lore, Fallon, these are other, you know, big Navy training ranges. They're seeing them there. Uh, Pax River where we do our test pilot training. Uh, they're having incidents up there.

plain: Navy pilots are said to be meeting UAP, the official term for unidentified aerial objects, not only off Norfolk and Virginia Beach and along the California coast but also further inland, at the big Navy training ranges at Lemoore and Fallon and at Pax River, where the Navy trains its test pilots. A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves tells Michels this from what other pilots have told him, saying 'they're having incidents up there'. If true, the objects would be showing up across many of the Navy's main flying areas, not just one.
